subject: How to retain the states of other tabs when adding new tabPanel to Shiny dashboard tabbox

messages.author: 5be9c0d5a64a1fae
messages.subject: How to retain the states of other tabs when adding new tabPanel to Shiny dashboard tabbox
parts:
Hi,

I'm currently using this approach to dynamically adding tabs to tabbox. Instead of having static content in all the tabs, I put some input and output(plots) in each tab, now the issue is every time a new tab is added, all the inputs and outputs in other tabs are gone(like a selection in a datatable or a plot). 

What I'm trying to do is to let user open an analysis in a new tab, so they can navigate among different analyses. 

Any help is appreciated.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to retain the states of other tabs when adding new tabPanel to Shiny dashboard tabbox
parts:
Dynamic tab functionality (adding/removing individual tabs) is coming natively to Shiny in the coming days (or up to a couple of weeks potentially): https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/1794

You could install from devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny@barbara/tabs") if you want to give it a try early. The API may change slightly before we merge to master though.
